```plato
//==
// # Splines
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Bezier splines
//  - B-splines and NURBS
//  - Hermite curves
//  - Interpolating splines

//==
// # Bezier splines
//
// Control-point curves of the Bezier family: arbitrary-degree Bezier curves,
// their rational (weighted) form, and chains of cubic segments. Parallel arrays
// (points + weights) must have equal counts; that invariant is documented rather
// than encoded. Evaluation lives in `splines.library.plato`.

//==
// # Bezier curves of arbitrary degree

// A Bezier curve of arbitrary degree in the plane: degree = control point
// count - 1 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve). Interpolates
// the first and last control points.
type BezierCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point2D>;
}
```
